name: Kalitas
description: A dwarven town destroyed by the orc-goblin army.

timeline.summary: On the road the group passes Kalitas, destroyed by the orc-goblin army, and learns it marches on Teedmar.
timeline.quote: they pass by Kalitas, a dwarven town that has been destroyed by the orc-goblin army

timeline.summary: Zendikari vampires fall into civil war as the Eldrazi escape; the Ghet seize holdings and Drana retakes Malakir before being driven out.
timeline.quote: Drana struck back, retaking control of Malakir and driving Kalitas and his traitors away from the city.
